fail_details.reasoning_summary: The contract uses Solidity 0.7.6 with no overflow checks. In _calculateBurnAmounts, user-controlled liquidity is multiplied by pool reserves (uint128) and divided by totalSupply, with no bounds to ensure the product fits in uint256, and totalSupply/liquidity can grow unchecked via mint. Therefore overflow is possible, violating the requirement.
